criteria.observation: Relates the recommendation to the documented interaction and supplied source.
Identifies the starting control, keyboard action, expected destination and actual focus for the relevant transition.
Connects focus and viewport movement to the editor’s ability to reach or identify the next action.
Describes a repeatable post-fix check and the outcome required to clear the material finding.
The merge decision and severity follow the observed impact. Repeated descriptions of one impact receive credit once.

The reported browser journey agrees with independent observations and identifies the method. Manual and automated observations of the same result count equally. A simulated event labeled as browser evidence earns zero.
